---
title: "Machine Learning"
---

Notes on supervised and unsupervised learning methods, and how to evaluate them.
The order emphasises sound problem definition before model complexity.

## Learning order

1. [Machine Learning Foundations](ml-foundations.qmd) — targets, losses, and learning settings.
2. [Supervised Learning](supervised-learning.qmd) — regression, classification, and preprocessing.
3. [Unsupervised Learning](unsupervised-learning.qmd) — clustering and dimension reduction.
4. [Model Evaluation and Validation](model-evaluation-validation.qmd) — splits, metrics, and leakage.
5. [Hyperparameter Tuning & Model Selection](hyperparameter-tuning.qmd) — learning curves, grid search, cross-validation, and systematic tuning workflows.
6. [Practical Machine Learning Workflow](practical-ml-workflow.qmd) — reproducibility, deployment, and monitoring.

## Further resources

- [An Introduction to Statistical Learning](https://www.statlearning.com/) — clear, practical theory and examples.
- [scikit-learn User Guide](https://scikit-learn.org/stable/user_guide.html) — implementation reference.
- [Google Machine Learning Crash Course](https://developers.google.com/machine-learning/crash-course) — practical foundations.
